trigger_condition: caller passes null, undefined, or non-array as lines
potential_consequence: TypeError thrown; detectPrompt never returns, crashing the driver

trigger_condition: lines array contains a null, undefined, or non-string element
potential_consequence: l.trimStart() throws TypeError; whole parse aborts mid-scan

trigger_condition: named confirm prompt (activate, installClaude) line ends with (Y/n) hint
potential_consequence: confirm message returned to driver includes raw (Y/n) hint text

trigger_condition: option label legitimately starts with '(' (e.g., '(beta) model-name')
guard_snippet: narrow filter to /^\(Use arrow keys\)/i or similar exact string rather than startsWith('(')
potential_consequence: valid option silently dropped; list returned with fewer items than on screen

trigger_condition: multiple '>' or '❯' markers present (display artifact or partial render)
guard_snippet: break after first sel=true, or track first rather than last selected position
potential_consequence: selectedIndex points to last marked line, not the actual cursor position

trigger_condition: caller passes lines array with more than 30 elements
guard_snippet: iterate up to Math.min(lines.length, 30) or slice before passing
potential_consequence: options beyond the viewport contract boundary are included in the returned list

trigger_condition: large TypeScript recording file causes many recursive next() calls inside term.write callback
guard_snippet: replace recursive call with setImmediate(next) or an iterative queue
potential_consequence: call stack exhausted on large recordings; capture tool crashes before completion

trigger_condition: credential prompt text is 20 chars or fewer (e.g., '? API key: ')
guard_snippet: remove or lower the length > 20 heuristic; gate solely on snapped.has('provider')
potential_consequence: short credential prompts never captured; fixture missing for that provider
